proTips.1: Profiles with professional photos receive 14x more views from recruiters. Make sure yours is well-lit and clear.
proTips.2: Use quantifiable achievements in your descriptions - numbers and percentages stand out to recruiters.
proTips.3: Include your GPA or honors if it was above 3.5 - it can make a big difference for recent graduates.
proTips.4: Adding 8-12 skills increases your match rate by up to 60%. Focus on your strongest abilities.
proTips.5: Being multilingual is a strong differentiator. List all languages you are at least conversational in.
proTips.6: Projects with clear outcomes and links to demos or repositories increase your recruiter response rate.
proTips.7: Verified certifications from recognized bodies boost your profile's credibility score significantly.
